project_type: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router application (React 19.2.4, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss). Stock create-next-app starter: a single static landing page at '/'.
build_system: npm (Next.js build pipeline). NOTE: npm is NOT on the default PATH. The working npm is at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin/npm. Prepend that dir to PATH: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". node is v22.23.3.
test_framework: None. There is no test framework, no test files, and no test script in package.json. Verification is done via `next build`, `eslint`, runtime inspection in a browser, and curl for HTTP headers.
test_command: No automated tests exist. Lint: `npm run lint`. Runtime verification: `npm run dev` (serves http://localhost:3000) or build+start, then browser automation + curl.
verification_instructions: 1) Install deps: npm install. 2) Build: npm run build (must succeed). 3) Lint: npm run lint. 4) Start dev server: npm run dev (http://localhost:3000). 5) Use a browser-automation power (playwright or agent-browser) to load the page at mobile/tablet/desktop viewport widths, capture screenshots, read the browser console for JS errors/warnings, and inspect network requests for failed/404/500 responses. 6) curl -I http://localhost:3000 to inspect response/security headers. All of this feeds the audit report; there is no pass/fail test suite.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next build produces /.next/ (gitignored) and next-env.d.ts (gitignored). No checked-in generated artifacts.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground; npm install. node_modules is currently MISSING and must be installed. Network mode is OPEN_INTERNET so the npm registry (verified reachable, HTTP 200) and external resources are available.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET: full network access, npm install and image pulls allowed. npm is not on PATH by default (see build_system). AGENTS.md warns that this Next.js version (16.2.4) has breaking changes vs older versions and that guides live under node_modules/next/dist/docs/ -- consult those before writing any Next.js code. Browser-automation powers available: 'playwright' (Playwright MCP) and 'agent-browser'; chromium is at /opt/playwright. This task is primarily audit/reporting, so no production code changes are expected unless the auditor recommends and applies a markup fix.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing Next.js code; heed deprecation notices. Steering (steering/demo.md): for every web app use responsive Tailwind CSS utility classes and semantic HTML for layout sections -- honor this for ANY markup fix recommended or applied during the audit.
key_patterns: App Router under app/. app/layout.tsx = root layout (Geist fonts via next/font/google, metadata title 'Create Next App', description 'Generated by create next app', lang='en', body uses flex flex-col min-h-full). app/page.tsx = static landing page: next/image Next.js logo (priority), h1 'To get started, edit the page.tsx file.', paragraph with two external text links (Templates, Learning) that LACK target/rel, and two CTA anchors ('Deploy Now', 'Documentation') that open external URLs with target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer. app/globals.css imports tailwindcss, defines light/dark CSS vars via prefers-color-scheme, @theme sets --font-sans to Geist, BUT body font-family is hardcoded to Arial/Helvetica/sans-serif (conflicts with Geist / --font-sans setup -- real inconsistency). next.config.ts is empty (no security headers configured).
directory_structure: app/ (layout.tsx, page.tsx, globals.css, favicon.ico) = all UI. public/ = static SVGs (next, vercel, file, globe, window). Root config: package.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs. Only route is '/'. No app/api, no middleware, no additional routes, no auth, no forms, no state.
